    An instance of a GameModel represents the game state of a single step.

    The GameUtils is a utility class that provides independent and mostly context free helper methods for information gathering and game logic.

    Collection of helper methods related to analytical operations on the ring.

    Collection of helper methods related to combats.

    Collection of helper methods for calculating and getting useful random values.

    Simple data container representing the result move composition of moves that take Fernies.

    Collection of helper methods related to the ring.

    Defines the output interface for the agents move in one step.
    IReader

    MoveWriter
    Concrete implementation of IMoveWriter.

    Represents a single node on the RINGWars game board.

    Usually used as a parameter in strategy methods for defining ordering modes.

    Entry point with the main method and main orchestration of the agent program.
